title: Public Job Research
description: Search public feeds across employers. Arbeitnow primarily covers Germany/Europe; Remotive provides a limited, delayed remote-job feed. No Indeed scraping, company list, or applications. Results retain source attribution. Feeds are cached for six hours.

sources.title: Job sources
sources.description: Select feeds to combine. These do not cover the entire job market.

jobTitles.title: Job titles or keywords
jobTitles.description: One alternative per entry. Every word within an entry must match (case insensitive, whole words). Example: AI automation requires both words; separate AI and automation entries match either. Title only by default.

searchInDescription.title: Also search descriptions
searchInDescription.description: Include description words in keyword matching; this can return less relevant jobs.

locations.title: Location text
locations.description: Optional alternatives matched against the source location text. No radius, country inference, or eligibility checking. Remote Worldwide will not match Poland automatically. Empty means no location restriction.

workplaceTypes.title: Work arrangement
workplaceTypes.description: Empty means all. Non-remote is not assumed to mean onsite. Hybrid/onsite require an explicit label.

jobTypes.title: Job types
jobTypes.description: Empty means all. Multiple selections are alternatives.

experienceLevels.title: Experience level
experienceLevels.description: Uses explicit title/feed labels. Unlabelled roles remain unknown.

datePosted.title: Feed publication date
datePosted.description: Feed dates can differ from the original employer posting date. Remotive has date-only precision and a 24-hour feed delay.

minimumSalary.title: Minimum salary
minimumSalary.description: Optional. A range matches when its upper bound reaches the minimum. No exchange-rate or period conversion. Salary data is sparse; Arbeitnow has no structured salary field.

salaryCurrency.title: Salary currency
salaryCurrency.description: Only explicit currencies are compared. A bare dollar sign is ambiguous.

salaryPeriod.title: Salary period
salaryPeriod.description: Only explicit periods are compared; annual pay is not inferred.

includeUnknownSalary.title: Keep unknown or non-comparable salaries
includeUnknownSalary.description: When a minimum is set, keep undisclosed, ambiguous, or different-currency/period salaries. Switch off to require a comparable salary.

includeUnknownMetadata.title: Keep unknown filter values
includeUnknownMetadata.description: When an arrangement, job type, experience or date filter is selected, retain jobs missing that metadata.

maxResults.title: Maximum matching jobs
maxResults.description: Newest matches saved, up to this limit. Deduplication is within a run using source ID and listing URL.

maxPages.title: Maximum Arbeitnow pages
maxPages.description: Fetch these pages once, then filter locally. Remotive uses one feed request regardless of this value. Strict filters may return zero matches.
